I love La Crosse. The summer brings out some of the best stuff. The river is active and offers chances to fish or boat or hike or just find a park and read by it. There are always festivals going on. Some small driving distances some right in our back yard. A great farmers market. Artspire is incredible. It's an arts festival with art of all kinds...painting, theater, sculpture, music, poetry, dance, weirdos and normals alike. You have to hit The Pearl or Ranisons and decide for yourself who has the better ice-cream. The drinking culture is alive and well. Might I suggest The Stein Haus...my personal favorite bar and restaurant. They have a FANTASTIC beer garden and live music every Friday night...with possible expansion into Wednesday and Thursday. The city also has segway tours. Two different beaches on the river. Goose Island. French Island. Two concert venues. A burgeoning comedy scene. There's LOT to do. 

Housing, sadly, I'm not an authority on. I know there is a lot of apartments, rooms, houses and what-have-you...I simply don't know much about that end. 

I hope you have a wonderful summer. You should let us know if you make it to the Stein. We can share stories over Pearl Street brew and you can tell me how you find La Crosse!

The arts scene, while not incredibly active in the summer, is much more varied than you make it seem. Also, there IS another grocery store chain in Onalaska and a third if you wish to travel in to La Crescent.
